name: Telecom Technology Development Fund
_eligibility_text:
The following Indian entities are only eligible for support from this fund.

   1. Domestic Company(ies) with focus on telecom R&amp;D, Use case development
   1. Startups / MSMEs
   1. Academic institutions
   1. R&amp;D institutions, Section 8 companies / Societies, Central &amp; State government entities / PSUs /Autonomous Bodies/SPVs / Limited liability partnerships- with a focus on telecom research and development
   1. Collaborative consortium of the above entities
   1. For Pilots: The above entities may partner, inter alia, with PSUs, TSPs, Central/State Government entities, government autonomous bodies, SPVs, etc.
   1. For Pilot application: Minimum TRL 7 is required.
